name: How to Add Page Numbers to a PDF
description: Stamp page numbers on every PDF page — Arabic, Roman or alphabetic formats.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Configure the numbering
step.text: Choose format (1,2,3 / i,ii,iii / a,b,c), position (top or bottom), font size, and which page to start numbering from.

step.name: Download the numbered PDF
step.text: Click 'Add Page Numbers'. Your document downloads with page numbers stamped on every page.
